title: Cheesy Filipino Chicken Skewers
description: A twist on the classic Filipino dish, these skewers are marinated in a sweet and savory mixture and served with a side of melted cheese.
instructions: Thread chicken, pineapple, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together teriyaki sauce, vinegar, and soy sauce.
Brush the marinade onto the skewers and let sit for 10 minutes.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, toast the cheese sticks by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven at 350°F for 5 minutes.
Serve the skewers with melted cheese and enjoy!
